<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <g id="status-bar">
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="20" x2="319" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="18" x2="324" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="16" x2="329" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="14" x2="334" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="21" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M345 18 Q350 13 355 18" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="365" y="15" width="19" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="17" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="384" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <g id="header">
    <line x1="20" y1="67" x2="370" y2="67" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="20" y="82" width="76" height="34" rx="5" fill="#F5C418"/>
    <text x="58" y="104" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">LOGO</text>
    <text x="370" y="103" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Help</text>
  </g>

  <g id="verification-card">
    <rect x="27" y="140" width="336" height="487" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="133" width="336" height="487" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <circle cx="188" cy="178" r="26" fill="#F5C418" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="174" y="168" width="28" height="20" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="175,170 188,180 201,170" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <text x="188" y="239" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Verify your email</text>
    <text x="188" y="271" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">We sent a 6-digit code to</text>
    <text x="188" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">jordan.miles@example.com</text>
    
    <text x="38" y="335" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Enter verification code</text>
    
    <g id="otp-input">
      <rect x="38" y="350" width="43" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="89" y="350" width="43" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="140" y="350" width="43" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="191" y="350" width="43" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="242" y="350" width="43" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="293" y="350" width="43" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="59" y="384" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">4</text>
      <line x1="108" y1="384" x2="113" y2="384" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="159" y1="384" x2="164" y2="384" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="210" y1="384" x2="215" y2="384" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="261" y1="384" x2="266" y2="384" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="312" y1="384" x2="317" y2="384" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
    
    <text x="38" y="426" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">The code expires in 09:42</text>
    
    <g id="continue-button">
      <rect x="38" y="452" width="300" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
      <text x="188" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Continue</text>
    </g>
    
    <g id="resend-button">
      <rect x="38" y="514" width="300" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="188" y="542" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Resend OTP</text>
    </g>
    
    <text x="188" y="588" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Wrong email address?</text>
    <text x="188" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Change email</text>
  </g>

  <g id="security-note">
    <circle cx="38" cy="660" r="10" fill="#F5C418" opacity="0.25"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="655" x2="38" y2="662" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="666" r="1" fill="#333333"/>
    <text x="56" y="658" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Never share your verification code with anyone.</text>
    <text x="56" y="677" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">It is only used to secure your account.</text>
  </g>

  <g id="legal">
    <text x="195" y="716" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
    <text x="195" y="737" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Terms of Use</text>
    <line x1="145" y1="740" x2="214" y2="740" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="223" y="737" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">and</text>
    <text x="246" y="737" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Privacy Policy</text>
    <line x1="246" y1="740" x2="326" y2="740" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <g id="bottom-navigation">
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <g transform="translate(29,783)">
      <polygon points="16,0 30,12 26,12 26,27 7,27 7,12 3,12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    
    <g transform="translate(121,783)">
      <circle cx="14" cy="13" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="21" y1="20" x2="28" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="14" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
    </g>
    
    <g transform="translate(214,783)">
      <polygon points="16,27 5,19 7,6 16,2 25,6 27,19" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
    </g>
    
    <g transform="translate(310,783)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="10" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="16" cy="25" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="16" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#F2C94C">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
